headline: Boomers Should Buy These High-Yield Dividend August Bargains Hand-Over-Fist
summary: Second-quarter earnings season shook loose some rare discounts on five high-yield dividend stocks that Wall Street analysts still rate as Buys, and income-focused investors may not get another shot at these prices.
